messages:
jordan: Heads up — when we ran the tenant migration smoke last night a bunch of small-tenants got mass-evicted from prefix cache, saw ~5x tail latencies. logs/metrics attached.

maria: ugh. which migration? the shard split one?

jordan: the split + epoch resync. repro steps in ops playbook. main issue looked like eviction hysteresis reset when new shard claims applied.

alex: can you paste the eviction log snippet?

jordan: ```
2024-03-12T03:12:41Z WARN eviction: tenant=tid-42 prefix=abc lease=epoch-7 action=demote reason=shard-claim
2024-03-12T03:12:41Z INFO prefetch: cancel prefix=abc inflight=3
2024-03-12T03:12:41Z WARN eviction: tenant=tid-42 prefix=abc action=evict force=true
```

maria: looks like we cancel prefetch then immediately force-evict without soft-grace. expected behavior is soft-demote then allow TTL to expire.

sam: were there any lease-fence rejections? that could trigger immediate evict.

jordan: no fence rejects. the new owner applied epoch 8 and we pushed demote -> null residency in same txn. race between demote processing and KV-heartbeat.

alex: theory: migration applies a hard demote to ensure no double-residency, but we don't propagate a grace window to other nodes. so they see no residency and evict.

maria: tradeoff: longer grace reduces churn during migration but increases memory pressure and affects hotset. need bounded grace.

sam: suggestion: add migration-phase tag on prefix leases. if migration-phase=true then use a bounded soft-grace of 200ms + credit holding; otherwise normal path.

jordan: +1. would that require new RPC signoff? we can piggyback on prefix metadata when lease transfer happens.

alex: implementable: on ownership transfer include "transfer_hint": {"grace_ms":"200","suppress_immediate_eviction":"true"}. runtime honors hint for Xms. fallback 100ms.

maria: ops concern: ops may run large migrating batches; need backpressure so grace doesn't pile up and OOM small hosts.

sam: combine hint with tenant-size heuristic: small tenants get 500ms, big tenants 50ms. prevents blowup.

jordan: can kernel-level batching help? if we delay evict by a single batch window we might suffice.

alex: code sketch:
```
if transfer_hint.present {
  demote_grace = min(transfer_hint.grace_ms, tenant_based_cap)
  schedule(evict, now+demote_grace)
} else {
  evict(now)
}
```

maria: also add metric: migration_eviction_rate and migration_grace_applied boolean tag.

sam: +alerts on migration_eviction_rate > 0.5% per minute

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: evict-grace-hint-handler -> canary on infra-1 tomorrow 09:00 UTC :eyes:

jordan: thanks. action items:
- alex to prototype transfer_hint wiring (ETA 2d)
- maria add telemetry + alert (ETA 1d)
- sam run chaos on migration path with varied batch sizes (ETA 3d)

alex: noted. I'll open RFC PR and a small spike branch.

maria: will add dashboards and a quick runbook for ops.

sam: adding chaos matrix to testgrid.

jordan: cool. ping me if you need tenant list to repro. thanks :thumbsup:
